k:学.mnemonic: Sparkles (⺌) above a forehead (冖), and a child (子) underneath. When a child studies hard the ideas sparkle above their forehead. Study.

examples.gloss: revival (of an old system, custom, fashion, etc.); restoration

r:汁.name: tsunami
r:汁.mnemonic: Three drops of water rushing in from the left. It looks small, but it is the front edge of a tsunami.

r:化.name: leader
r:化.mnemonic: A person standing tall on the left, leading everyone who follows. The leader always stands at the front (left) of the kanji.

r:扎.name: fingers
r:扎.mnemonic: A hand seen from the side with its fingers spread out. Whenever you see it, the kanji is about doing something with your fingers.

r:艾.name: flowers
r:艾.mnemonic: Two little sprouts poking up through a line of soil. Give them a season and they become flowers.

r:込.name: path
r:込.mnemonic: A winding path with a splash of dust kicked up at the end. Anything on this path is going somewhere.

r:冖.name: forehead
r:冖.mnemonic: A flat cover sitting on top of things, like a forehead sitting above a face.

r:宀.name: roof
r:宀.mnemonic: A roof with a little chimney on top. Whatever sits under it is indoors.

r:夂.name: trudge
r:夂.mnemonic: A figure with heavy legs, trudging slowly through deep snow.

r:勹.name: cradle
r:勹.mnemonic: A pair of arms curling round to cradle something small against the chest.

r:儿.name: legs
r:儿.mnemonic: Two legs, walking. Whatever sits above them is being carried around.

r:尸.name: flag
r:尸.mnemonic: A flag hanging from a pole. In old kanji it was a lying body, but a flag is easier to picture.

r:刈.name: knife
r:刈.mnemonic: A knife standing on its point at the right edge of the kanji, ready to cut.

r:阡.name: mound
r:阡.note: Left-side form of 阜 (mound). Same glyph as borough but on the left.
r:阡.mnemonic: A stack of earth on the LEFT: a mound of dirt piled up beside the kanji.

r:邦.name: borough
r:邦.note: Right-side form of 邑 (village). Same glyph as mound but on the right.
r:邦.mnemonic: The same stack on the RIGHT is a borough: a crowded little district of houses.

r:隹.name: turkey
r:隹.mnemonic: A fat, stubby-tailed bird with a big body: a turkey.

r:厶.name: cocoon
r:厶.mnemonic: A little cocoon, closed up tight, keeping whatever is inside private.

r:ヨ.name: broom
r:ヨ.mnemonic: A broom head with three stiff bristles, seen from the side.

r:尚.name: sparkle
r:尚.mnemonic: Three sparkles hovering above the kanji.

r:禾.name: grain
r:禾.mnemonic: A rice plant whose head droops under the weight of its grain.

r:忙.name: heartbeat
r:忙.mnemonic: A heart squeezed into the left side, still beating. Kanji with it are about emotions.

r:攵.name: strike
r:攵.mnemonic: A hand holding a stick raised to strike. It always appears on the right, doing something to the left half.

r:ノ.name: slide
r:ノ.mnemonic: A playground slide, sloping down to the left.

r:戈.name: halberd
r:戈.mnemonic: A spear with a hooked blade on one side: a halberd.

r:厂.name: overhang
r:厂.mnemonic: A rock overhang; anything under it is sheltered from the rain.

r:广.name: canopy
r:广.mnemonic: A canopy with a pole on the left, like a market stall roof.

r:冂.name: hood
r:冂.mnemonic: A hood pulled down over the top of the kanji, open at the bottom.

r:廾.name: twenty
r:廾.mnemonic: Two hands held up together, ten fingers each: twenty.

r:艮.name: stubborn
r:艮.mnemonic: A person with their heels dug in, refusing to move: stubborn.

r:匕.name: spoon
r:匕.mnemonic: A spoon lying on its side.

r:个.name: hat
r:个.mnemonic: A pointed hat sitting on top of the kanji.

r:卩.name: stamp
r:卩.mnemonic: A rubber stamp seen from the side.

r:頁.name: page
r:頁.mnemonic: A page of a book with a big heading at the top.

r:買.name: net
r:買.mnemonic: A fishing net stretched flat, seen from above.

r:彳.name: stroll
r:彳.mnemonic: Two small steps and a stride: someone strolling along.

r:杰.name: flames
r:杰.mnemonic: Four little flames licking up from underneath.

r:冫.name: icicles
r:冫.mnemonic: Two icicles hanging from the left side.

r:疔.name: sickbed
r:疔.mnemonic: A bed with a canopy, seen from the side, with a patient lying in it.

r:凵.name: pit
r:凵.mnemonic: A pit dug into the ground, open at the top.

r:酉.name: wine jar
r:酉.mnemonic: A jar with a wide lid and something sloshing inside: a wine jar.

r:卜.name: divining rod
r:卜.mnemonic: A forked stick used for finding water: a divining rod.

r:殳.name: weapon
r:殳.mnemonic: A hand gripping a long weapon.

r:ハ.name: fins
r:ハ.mnemonic: Two fins, one on each side.

r:犯.name: hound
r:犯.mnemonic: A dog drawn in three strokes, standing on its hind legs on the left: a hound.

r:几.name: table
r:几.mnemonic: A small table with two legs.

r:已.name: cobra
r:已.mnemonic: A cobra rearing up with its hood open.

r:礼.name: altar
r:礼.mnemonic: A small altar on the left, with offerings placed on top.

r:豕.name: pig
r:豕.mnemonic: A pig with its snout down, rooting in the dirt.

r:彡.name: whiskers
r:彡.mnemonic: Three whiskers, always sticking out to the right.

r:囗.name: fence
r:囗.note: Enclosure (not the same as 口 mouth: it is bigger and wraps around).
r:囗.mnemonic: A fence built all the way round whatever is inside.

r:初.name: cloak
r:初.mnemonic: A cloak thrown over the left shoulder.

r:虍.name: tiger stripes
r:虍.mnemonic: The stripes and gaping mouth of a tiger, seen from the front.

r:亠.name: lid
r:亠.mnemonic: A lid with a knob on top.

r:聿.name: brush
r:聿.mnemonic: A hand holding a writing brush upright.

r:禹.name: paw print
r:禹.mnemonic: A paw print pressed into the mud.

r:匚.name: crate
r:匚.mnemonic: An open crate lying on its side.

r:疋.name: bolt
r:疋.mnemonic: A bolt of cloth standing on end.

r:爿.name: plank
r:爿.mnemonic: A plank of wood standing on its end.

r:マ.name: muzzle
r:マ.mnemonic: A dog muzzle, the strap and the cage.

r:隶.name: servant
r:隶.mnemonic: A servant bent over, scrubbing the floor.

r:辰.name: clam
r:辰.mnemonic: A clam with its shell half open.

r:弋.name: peg
r:弋.mnemonic: A peg driven into the ground with a rope tied round it.

r:韋.name: tanned hide
r:韋.mnemonic: An animal hide stretched out on a frame to be tanned.

r:ユ.name: handle
r:ユ.mnemonic: A bent handle, the kind on a bucket.

r:癶.name: tent
r:癶.mnemonic: A tent with its flaps open.

r:老.name: elder
r:老.mnemonic: An elder leaning on a stick.

r:也.name: scorpion
r:也.mnemonic: A scorpion with its tail curled up.

r:舛.name: dancing legs
r:舛.mnemonic: Two legs kicking in opposite directions: dancing legs.

r:耒.name: plow
r:耒.mnemonic: A wooden plow with its blade at the bottom.

r:乞.name: hairpin
r:乞.mnemonic: A hairpin with a bent tip.

r:滴.name: podium
r:滴.mnemonic: A podium with a speaker standing on it.

r:巛.name: stream
r:巛.mnemonic: Three curving lines of running water: a stream.

r:而.name: rake
r:而.mnemonic: A rake with its teeth pointing down.

r:屮.name: sprout
r:屮.mnemonic: A single sprout with two leaves.

r:尤.name: wobble
r:尤.mnemonic: A figure with one leg bent, wobbling.

r:鬲.name: cauldron
r:鬲.mnemonic: A cauldron standing on three legs.

r:釆.name: sift
r:釆.mnemonic: Grains falling through a sieve: sifting.

r:尢.name: limp
r:尢.mnemonic: A person with one crooked leg, walking with a limp.

r:巴.name: swirl
r:巴.mnemonic: A swirl of water going down a drain.

r:彑.name: snout
r:彑.mnemonic: A pig's snout seen from the front.

r:瓜.name: melon
r:瓜.mnemonic: A melon hanging from its vine.

r:气.name: vapor
r:气.mnemonic: Vapor curling up from a hot spring.

r:乃.name: scythe
r:乃.mnemonic: A scythe with a curved blade.

r:奄.name: smother
r:奄.mnemonic: A big blanket (大) thrown over the electricity (電 without rain) to smother it.

r:髟.name: mane
r:髟.mnemonic: Long hair flowing out: a mane.
